parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, made of durable plastic material. It is flat and designed to support the user's weight.
parts.Functional_description: The seat provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing weight evenly and ensuring comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It folds upward along the hinge mechanism when the chair is collapsed for storage.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the folding chair, made of steel tubing for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and backrest, providing structural integrity and allowing the folding mechanism to operate.
parts.Movement_description: The base body folds inward at the joints, enabling the chair to collapse into a compact form for easy storage.
